summary: Zirconium silicate films were deposited on Si(100) substrates using Zr(NEt2)4 and Si(OnBu)4 precursors. The films exhibited an amorphous structure up to 800°C and showed low hysteresis and leakage current density, making them suitable for gate dielectric applications. The study aimed to develop high-k dielectrics for sub-0.1 μm CMOS technology.
evidence: Zirconium silicate films were deposited on Si(100) substrates at 400°C by CVD. The films were amorphous up to 800°C and showed low hysteresis and leakage current density. The study aimed to develop high-k dielectrics for sub-0.1 μm CMOS technology.
